name: Runtime Config Convergence
description: Runtime config management for moltbot personas. Provides set_secret (env secrets) and set_config (runtime config) tools — formerly the manage-secrets plugin — plus drift detection between live runtime OpenClaw config and repo-rendered desired config. Maintains a PVC-local candidate queue, sends one direct chat notification per new non-ignored candidate, and surfaces a /config-drift command for review. Drift v1: detector + queue + notifications only — no auto-promotion.

liveConfigPath.description: Optional explicit file read for byte/hash use cases. Default current-config access uses runtime.config.current() / ctx.config.

queuePath.description: Override path for the candidate queue JSON file. Default: ${OPENCLAW_HOME or ~/.openclaw}/runtime-config-convergence/queue.json

desiredConfigPath.description: Path to the rendered desired openclaw.json (mounted by chart/env).

ownershipPolicyPath.description: Path to the ownership/secrets policy file (mounted by chart/env).

scanIntervalMs.description: Plugin-service scan cadence. Set to 0 to disable interval scans (commands and HTTP route will still trigger).

expectedSecretDriftNotify.description: Whether to notify on expected-secret-drift candidates (default: false; informational suppress).

httpRoute.description: Optional HTTP trigger route. When set, registers an in-pod endpoint that runs one scan when invoked.
